title: abi.encodePacked used to build dynamic-string metadata in uri() (cosmetic)
description: uri() builds dynamic-string metadata with abi.encodePacked (NFTMinterV2.sol:262-273). The packed output is returned as a metadata JSON string and is never hashed, so no collision/identity impact materializes. The original collision concern was based on a misread (no keccak256 on this output).
impact: None. Output is a returned metadata JSON string, never hashed.
attackPath: No security path; original collision concern was based on a misread (no keccak256 on this output).
recommendation: Prefer abi.encode (or string.concat) for dynamic-string concatenation clarity; cosmetic only.
justification: Cosmetic style note, no security impact -> QA.
